title: SurvICL: a Foundation Model for in-context Survival Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.22242v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) now outperform gradient-boosted trees in classification and regression. Yet in survival analysis, which predicts when an event occurs from censored data, often on small clinical cohorts, we find that no existing TFM beats the half-century-old Cox model. We address this issue by introducing SurvICL, a TFM that predicts survival curves in-context. SurvICL is pretrained on purely synthetic datasets generated from a novel flexible proportional-odds prior that outperforms other prior types in our ablation study. Unlike most other survival models, SurvICL is trained with a plain quantile regression loss, which is possible because its synthetic pre-training data generator can provide uncensored event times. Additionally, we introduce the largest survival benchmark to date spanning 103 datasets. On the 63 datasets held out from all design decisions, SurvICL outperforms 20 tree-based, deep, and foundation-model

translated_title: SurvICL：一个用于上下文生存分析的基础模型
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFM）目前在分类和回归任务上已超越梯度提升树。然而在生存分析领域——即从删失数据中预测事件发生时间，且通常基于小规模临床队列——我们发现现有TFM均无法击败拥有半个世纪历史的Cox模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SurvICL，一个能够以上下文学习方式预测生存曲线的表格基础模型。SurvICL在纯合成数据集上进行预训练，这些数据由我们提出的一种新型灵活比例几率先验生成，该先验在消融研究中表现优于其他类型的先验。与大多数其他生存分析模型不同，SurvICL采用简单的分位数回归损失进行训练，这之所以可行，是因为其合成预训练数据生成器能够提供未删失的事件时间。此外，我们推出了迄今为止规模最大的生存分析基准，涵盖103个数据集。在从所有设计决策中保留的63个数据集上，SurvICL超越了20种基于树的方法、深度学习方法和基础模型。
tldr: SurvICL是一个通过新型比例几率先验生成合成数据并以分位数回归损失预训练的上下文生存分析基础模型，首次超越经典Cox模型，并配套推出了迄今最大的103数据集生存分析基准。
en_tdlr: SurvICL is an in-context survival analysis foundation model pretrained on synthetic data generated from a novel flexible proportional-odds prior with a quantile regression loss, which for the first time outperforms the classic Cox model and is accompanied by the largest survival benchmark to date spanning 103 datasets.
